commitments.detail: Revoking credentials used in affected builds to prevent further exposure.
Performing a thorough codebase security review across all six repositories to identify and mitigate similar vulnerabilities.
Notifying customers within 24 hours of the incident to inform them of the potential risk and steps being taken to address it.
Retaining all evidence related to this incident for at least 90 days for audit and investigation purposes.
Obtaining signoff from both internal and external auditors to ensure compliance with relevant security standards and regulations.
